results.comment: 3:09. So I’m a rare breed of idiot. I was like 19 or something and went “hmm. Well, I’ve been fairly normal with my emotions. And happiness is seemingly the most 2 dimensional, boring and useless of all the emotions. I’m never driven to do something if I’m happy. So, lemme simplify my life and cut it out a bit. This pattern of thinking “happiness= a wast of time” eventually became automatic and, I would rather think sad, depressing thoughts than happy ones. I actually gave myself depression. Like, bad depression. Like 2 years into this and I was like “wait. I’m depressed. And I actually did this deliberately. Broooo. I’m an idiot” and laughed my ass off for like 20 mins. So than I was like “ok. Some happiness is way more useful than none at all. Imma just think some happy thoughts again, even if I think they are delusional, and maybe I can balance out and forget this ever happened. And like 4 months later, that worked. So yeah. I think if you are in the opposite boat where you think happiness is dumb….don’t like use this video as confirmation bias. You have to at least see it as like, neutral. Because, it is important. Like, why tf would you ever commit to anything or take a risk if it’s not gonna work out. Or like, go out if your comfort zone if you don’t care. It’s like, these sorts of videos are decent for those who already properly understand what this dude is talking about. It’s like “oh yeah. I’ve been slacking. Thank you.” But, if you are 19 year old me, and an idiot….think first. Lmfao.
